title: Bringing the power of Legora across Microsoft 365
summary: Legal work runs across Microsoft 365. Legora brings the requests, information, and legal work closer together.
body_markdown:
Legal work runs across Microsoft 365. Legora brings the requests, information, and legal work closer together.


Our latest additions are Intake for Teams and Outlook, agentic search across Outlook and Calendar, an Excel add-in, and an expanded connection to Microsoft 365 Copilot.


They make it easier to start work, find relevant context, and use Legora's legal capabilities in familiar tools.


#### Turn ad-hoc requests from Teams and Outlook into tracked work


Legal requests arrive from across the business, often through Teams messages and shared inboxes. Gathering information, routing requests, and coordinating work takes valuable time away from the legal questions themselves.


With Legora Intake for Teams and Outlook, colleagues can submit a request to the legal team from the tools they already use. Mention “@Legora” in Teams or email a connected shared mailbox, and Legora gathers the necessary information and turns the request into a tracked task. The Agent can then begin the work using your team's Skills and playbooks, with a lawyer accountable throughout.


For Outlook requests, follow-up questions stay in the same email thread, so colleagues can respond without changing how they work.


Your business gets a simple way to access legal support, while your legal team can spend less time managing requests and more time delivering advice.


#### Find the emails and calendar context behind a matter with the Legora Agent


A contract rarely contains the full negotiating history. Key instructions and concessions may sit in emails or meeting details, leaving lawyers to gather them before they can assess the latest draft.


With the new Outlook email and Calendar integration, the Legora Agent can search connected emails and attachments, and find relevant calendar details. Ask it to retrieve the correspondence behind a negotiating position or identify meetings linked to a matter.


The Agent can use that context alongside documents in Legora to review provisions, identify issues, and prepare drafts. It can also help draft follow-up emails or schedule meetings, with your approval before anything is sent or booked.


Lawyers spend less time reconstructing a matter and more time acting on legal questions with all the supporting information right in front of them.


#### Build, organize and analyze spreadsheets with the Legora Agent


Transaction schedules, due diligence trackers, and financial data often require hours of manual preparation before lawyers can focus on the findings.


With the new **Legora Excel add-in** , you can ask the Agent to populate templates, build formulas, format data, and create pivot tables directly in your workbook. It works with your selected cells and asks for approval before making changes.


Your team can spend less time preparing spreadsheets and more time analyzing the information, investigating issues, and making decisions.


#### Ask Legora from Microsoft Copilot


Legal questions come up throughout the working day, often while you're already working in Microsoft 365. Switching between applications to find answers can interrupt the work at hand.


With the Legora plugin in Copilot for Legal, you can ask the Legora Agent to research legal questions, compare contractual clauses, and assess risks directly from Copilot. You can initiate the conversation in Legora to review the underlying sources and continue the work.


Your team gets more ways to work with Legora, bringing its legal research and analysis capabilities into the applications they use every day.


#### **The power of Legora, wherever you work**


These launches build on our existing integrations with Word, Outlook, SharePoint, and OneDrive, bringing more of Microsoft 365 together with Legora's legal operating system.


Wherever work begins, your team can access the context it needs, put Legora's legal capabilities to work, and deliver the results in familiar formats, from Word documents to Excel workbooks and PowerPoint presentations.


We're building a more connected experience across Legora and Microsoft 365, bringing together the best of both platforms so lawyers can focus on the judgement their stakeholders depend on them for.


We'll be at Microsoft Ignite in San Francisco, November 17–20. Drop by booth #1726 for a demo on these new products.
